chunks: Ali, from Abi Ahmad ibn Rashid, from Abi Hashim al-Ja'fari, who said:

I complained to Abi Muhammad عليه السلام of need, so he scratched the ground with his whip. He said: And I think he covered it with a cloth, and he brought out five hundred dinars. Then he said: O Aba Hashim, take, and excuse us.
ai.seo_question: How did Imam Abu Muhammad عليه السلام respond when Abu Hashim al-Ja'fari complained of financial need?
ai.summary: This hadith narrates that Abu Hashim al-Ja'fari complained of financial need to Imam Abu Muhammad عليه السلام, who then produced five hundred dinars and gave them to him. The report highlights the Imam's generosity and his extraordinary act in relieving a believer's hardship.

en.hubeali: Ali, from Abu Ahmad Bin Rashid, from Abu Hashim Al Ja’fary who said,

‘I complained to Abu Muhammad<sup>asws</sup> (11<sup>th</sup> Imam<sup>asws</sup>) of the need, so he<sup>asws</sup> struck the ground with his<sup>asws</sup> whip. And I reckon he<sup>asws</sup> covered it with a towel and extracted five hundred Dinars, and he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘O Abu Hashim! Take, and excuse us<sup>asws</sup>’.
en.sarwar: 5. Ali has narrated from abu Ahmad ibn Rashid from abu Hashim al-Ja‘fari who has said the following.

“I requested abu Muhammad for something that I needed. He scratched the earth with his whip. The narrator has said that I think he then covered it with a handkerchief and then took out five hundred Dinars. He then said, “O abu Hashim take it and grants us pardon.”
